 - `/admin/community` manages the permanent community, including polls, project
   moderation, participants, memberships, payments, and room analytics.
 - `/admin/recording-studio` records any number of available cameras, screen shares,
-  and optional microphones as separate local tracks. One capture coordinator starts
-  and stops them on a shared clock; losing a source or a storage write stops the take.
+  and optional microphones. A newly configured camera defaults to recording its selected
+  system-default or chosen microphone inside the same video file; video-only is an explicit
+  choice. The live camera preview is muted, while a track-presence indicator and live level
+  meter describe the captured microphone. Standalone microphone and screen sources remain
+  available, and an already configured matching microphone is cloned without transferring
+  ownership or adding a second audio track to the camera file. Versioned browser-local source
+  preferences survive recording stops and reloads; restoration never starts capture or requests
+  permission by itself. One capture coordinator starts and stops sources on a shared clock; losing
+  a required source or a storage write stops the take.
   IndexedDB commits each chunk together with its counters; a feature-detected selected-directory destination
   closes immutable media fragments before its small authoritative checkpoint and stores only handles/metadata in
   IndexedDB. Recovery can reconnect or import that folder without moving its media into origin storage; read-only

   matching microphone track safely when it is also configured as a standalone source. Recording metadata and archive

   from combinations accepted by the active browser, with construction-time fallback; standalone audio remains separate.
+  Verification on Windows 10 Pro build 19045 used Playwright Chromium 151.0.7922.34 and Firefox 153.0: the full
+  Chromium recording-studio suite passed 9/9, the camera export contained audible audio, and 240 ms visual/audio
+  markers stayed within 150 ms at the beginning and end in both engines. The permission UI also distinguishes denied,
+  busy, and absent-device retries before an explicit silent-video choice. Chromium reported WebM VP9/Opus, WebM
+  VP8/Opus, generic WebM, and MP4 H.264/AAC candidates; Firefox reported WebM VP8/Opus and generic WebM, so the
+  recorder falls through to the first supported combination. The bundled Playwright WebKit 26.5 on Windows has no
+  `MediaRecorder` and disables the studio; this does not describe native Safari. The reported macOS device/browser
+  setup was not available in this workspace, so its hardware verification remains outstanding.

 - `/admin/community` manages the permanent community, including polls, project
   moderation, participants, memberships, payments, and room analytics.
 - `/admin/recording-studio` records any number of available cameras, screen shares,
-  and optional microphones as separate local tracks. One capture coordinator starts
-  and stops them on a shared clock; losing a source or a storage write stops the take.
+  and optional microphones. A newly configured camera defaults to recording its selected
+  system-default or chosen microphone inside the same video file; video-only is an explicit
+  choice. The live camera preview is muted, while a track-presence indicator and live level
+  meter describe the captured microphone. Standalone microphone and screen sources remain
+  available, and an already configured matching microphone is cloned without transferring
+  ownership or adding a second audio track to the camera file. Versioned browser-local source
+  preferences survive recording stops and reloads; restoration never starts capture or requests
+  permission by itself. One capture coordinator starts and stops sources on a shared clock; losing
+  a required source or a storage write stops the take.
   IndexedDB commits each chunk together with its counters; a feature-detected selected-directory destination
   closes immutable media fragments before its small authoritative checkpoint and stores only handles/metadata in
   IndexedDB. Recovery can reconnect or import that folder without moving its media into origin storage; read-only

+  busy, and absent-device retries before an explicit silent-video choice. Chromium reported WebM VP9/Opus, WebM
+  VP8/Opus, generic WebM, and MP4 H.264/AAC candidates; Firefox reported WebM VP8/Opus and generic WebM, so the
+  recorder falls through to the first supported combination. The bundled Playwright WebKit 26.5 on Windows has no
+  `MediaRecorder` and disables the studio; this does not describe native Safari. The reported macOS device/browser

 - `/admin/community` manages the permanent community, including polls, project
   moderation, participants, memberships, payments, and room analytics.
 - `/admin/recording-studio` records any number of available cameras, screen shares,
-  and optional microphones as separate local tracks. One capture coordinator starts
-  and stops them on a shared clock; losing a source or a storage write stops the take.
+  and optional microphones. A newly configured camera defaults to recording its selected
+  system-default or chosen microphone inside the same video file; video-only is an explicit
+  choice. The live camera preview is muted, while a track-presence indicator and live level
+  meter describe the captured microphone. Standalone microphone and screen sources remain
+  available, and an already configured matching microphone is cloned without transferring
+  ownership or adding a second audio track to the camera file. Versioned browser-local source
+  preferences survive recording stops and reloads; restoration never starts capture or requests
+  permission by itself. One capture coordinator starts and stops sources on a shared clock; losing
+  a required source or a storage write stops the take.
   IndexedDB commits each chunk together with its counters; a feature-detected selected-directory destination
   closes immutable media fragments before its small authoritative checkpoint and stores only handles/metadata in
   IndexedDB. Recovery can reconnect or import that folder without moving its media into origin storage; read-only

+  markers stayed within 150 ms at the beginning and end in both engines. The permission UI also distinguishes denied,
+  busy, and absent-device retries before an explicit silent-video choice. Chromium reported WebM VP9/Opus, WebM
+  VP8/Opus, generic WebM, and MP4 H.264/AAC candidates; Firefox reported WebM VP8/Opus and generic WebM, so the
+  recorder falls through to the first supported combination. The bundled Playwright WebKit 26.5 on Windows has no
+  `MediaRecorder` and disables the studio; this does not describe native Safari. The reported macOS device/browser

 - `/admin/community` manages the permanent community, including polls, project
   moderation, participants, memberships, payments, and room analytics.
 - `/admin/recording-studio` records any number of available cameras, screen shares,
-  and optional microphones as separate local tracks. One capture coordinator starts
-  and stops them on a shared clock; losing a source or a storage write stops the take.
+  and optional microphones. A newly configured camera defaults to recording its selected
+  system-default or chosen microphone inside the same video file; video-only is an explicit
+  choice. The live camera preview is muted, while a track-presence indicator and live level
+  meter describe the captured microphone. Standalone microphone and screen sources remain
+  available, and an already configured matching microphone is cloned without transferring
+  ownership or adding a second audio track to the camera file. Versioned browser-local source
+  preferences survive recording stops and reloads; restoration never starts capture or requests
+  permission by itself. One capture coordinator starts and stops sources on a shared clock; losing
+  a required source or a storage write stops the take.
   IndexedDB commits each chunk together with its counters; a feature-detected selected-directory destination
   closes immutable media fragments before its small authoritative checkpoint and stores only handles/metadata in
   IndexedDB. Recovery can reconnect or import that folder without moving its media into origin storage; read-only

 - `/admin/community` manages the permanent community, including polls, project
   moderation, participants, memberships, payments, and room analytics.
 - `/admin/recording-studio` records any number of available cameras, screen shares,
-  and optional microphones as separate local tracks. One capture coordinator starts
-  and stops them on a shared clock; losing a source or a storage write stops the take.
+  and optional microphones. A newly configured camera defaults to recording its selected
+  system-default or chosen microphone inside the same video file; video-only is an explicit
+  choice. The live camera preview is muted, while a track-presence indicator and live level
+  meter describe the captured microphone. Standalone microphone and screen sources remain
+  available, and an already configured matching microphone is cloned without transferring
+  ownership or adding a second audio track to the camera file. Versioned browser-local source
+  preferences survive recording stops and reloads; restoration never starts capture or requests
+  permission by itself. One capture coordinator starts and stops sources on a shared clock; losing
+  a required source or a storage write stops the take.
   IndexedDB commits each chunk together with its counters; a feature-detected selected-directory destination
   closes immutable media fragments before its small authoritative checkpoint and stores only handles/metadata in
   IndexedDB. Recovery can reconnect or import that folder without moving its media into origin storage; read-only

   matching microphone track safely when it is also configured as a standalone source. Recording metadata and archive
   manifests now identify embedded camera audio and its selected microphone. Recorder containers and codecs are chosen
   from combinations accepted by the active browser, with construction-time fallback; standalone audio remains separate.
+  Verification on Windows 10 Pro build 19045 used Playwright Chromium 151.0.7922.34 and Firefox 153.0: the full
+  Chromium recording-studio suite passed 9/9, the camera export contained audible audio, and 240 ms visual/audio
+  markers stayed within 150 ms at the beginning and end in both engines. The permission UI also distinguishes denied,
+  busy, and absent-device retries before an explicit silent-video choice. Chromium reported WebM VP9/Opus, WebM
+  VP8/Opus, generic WebM, and MP4 H.264/AAC candidates; Firefox reported WebM VP8/Opus and generic WebM, so the
+  recorder falls through to the first supported combination. The bundled Playwright WebKit 26.5 on Windows has no
+  `MediaRecorder` and disables the studio; this does not describe native Safari. The reported macOS device/browser
+  setup was not available in this workspace, so its hardware verification remains outstanding.
 
 - Quick-link materials now pass only the trimmed original pasted URL as their body to ordinary material creation,
   preserving URL spelling, percent encoding, query strings and fragments. Scraped titles, fallback titles and title

 - `/admin/community` manages the permanent community, including polls, project

 - `/admin/recording-studio` records any number of available cameras, screen shares,
-  and optional microphones as separate local tracks. One capture coordinator starts
-  and stops them on a shared clock; losing a source or a storage write stops the take.
+  and optional microphones. A newly configured camera defaults to recording its selected
+  system-default or chosen microphone inside the same video file; video-only is an explicit
+  choice. The live camera preview is muted, while a track-presence indicator and live level
+  meter describe the captured microphone. Standalone microphone and screen sources remain
+  available, and an already configured matching microphone is cloned without transferring
+  ownership or adding a second audio track to the camera file. Versioned browser-local source
+  preferences survive recording stops and reloads; restoration never starts capture or requests
+  permission by itself. One capture coordinator starts and stops sources on a shared clock; losing
+  a required source or a storage write stops the take.
   IndexedDB commits each chunk together with its counters; a feature-detected selected-directory destination
   closes immutable media fragments before its small authoritative checkpoint and stores only handles/metadata in
   IndexedDB. Recovery can reconnect or import that folder without moving its media into origin storage; read-only

 - `/admin/community` manages the permanent community, including polls, project
   moderation, participants, memberships, payments, and room analytics.
 - `/admin/recording-studio` records any number of available cameras, screen shares,
-  and optional microphones as separate local tracks. One capture coordinator starts
-  and stops them on a shared clock; losing a source or a storage write stops the take.
+  and optional microphones. A newly configured camera defaults to recording its selected
+  system-default or chosen microphone inside the same video file; video-only is an explicit
+  choice. The live camera preview is muted, while a track-presence indicator and live level
+  meter describe the captured microphone. Standalone microphone and screen sources remain
+  available, and an already configured matching microphone is cloned without transferring
+  ownership or adding a second audio track to the camera file. Versioned browser-local source
+  preferences survive recording stops and reloads; restoration never starts capture or requests
+  permission by itself. One capture coordinator starts and stops sources on a shared clock; losing
+  a required source or a storage write stops the take.
   IndexedDB commits each chunk together with its counters; a feature-detected selected-directory destination
   closes immutable media fragments before its small authoritative checkpoint and stores only handles/metadata in
   IndexedDB. Recovery can reconnect or import that folder without moving its media into origin storage; read-only

+  recorder falls through to the first supported combination. The bundled Playwright WebKit 26.5 on Windows has no

 - `/admin/community` manages the permanent community, including polls, project
   moderation, participants, memberships, payments, and room analytics.
 - `/admin/recording-studio` records any number of available cameras, screen shares,
-  and optional microphones as separate local tracks. One capture coordinator starts
-  and stops them on a shared clock; losing a source or a storage write stops the take.
+  and optional microphones. A newly configured camera defaults to recording its selected
+  system-default or chosen microphone inside the same video file; video-only is an explicit
+  choice. The live camera preview is muted, while a track-presence indicator and live level
+  meter describe the captured microphone. Standalone microphone and screen sources remain
+  available, and an already configured matching microphone is cloned without transferring
+  ownership or adding a second audio track to the camera file. Versioned browser-local source
+  preferences survive recording stops and reloads; restoration never starts capture or requests
+  permission by itself. One capture coordinator starts and stops sources on a shared clock; losing
+  a required source or a storage write stops the take.
   IndexedDB commits each chunk together with its counters; a feature-detected selected-directory destination
   closes immutable media fragments before its small authoritative checkpoint and stores only handles/metadata in
   IndexedDB. Recovery can reconnect or import that folder without moving its media into origin storage; read-only

+  busy, and absent-device retries before an explicit silent-video choice. Chromium reported WebM VP9/Opus, WebM
+  VP8/Opus, generic WebM, and MP4 H.264/AAC candidates; Firefox reported WebM VP8/Opus and generic WebM, so the
+  recorder falls through to the first supported combination. The bundled Playwright WebKit 26.5 on Windows has no

 - `/admin/community` manages the permanent community, including polls, project
   moderation, participants, memberships, payments, and room analytics.
 - `/admin/recording-studio` records any number of available cameras, screen shares,
-  and optional microphones as separate local tracks. One capture coordinator starts
-  and stops them on a shared clock; losing a source or a storage write stops the take.
+  and optional microphones. A newly configured camera defaults to recording its selected
+  system-default or chosen microphone inside the same video file; video-only is an explicit
+  choice. The live camera preview is muted, while a track-presence indicator and live level
+  meter describe the captured microphone. Standalone microphone and screen sources remain
+  available, and an already configured matching microphone is cloned without transferring
+  ownership or adding a second audio track to the camera file. Versioned browser-local source
+  preferences survive recording stops and reloads; restoration never starts capture or requests
+  permission by itself. One capture coordinator starts and stops sources on a shared clock; losing
+  a required source or a storage write stops the take.
   IndexedDB commits each chunk together with its counters; a feature-detected selected-directory destination
   closes immutable media fragments before its small authoritative checkpoint and stores only handles/metadata in
   IndexedDB. Recovery can reconnect or import that folder without moving its media into origin storage; read-only

   matching microphone track safely when it is also configured as a standalone source. Recording metadata and archive

   from combinations accepted by the active browser, with construction-time fallback; standalone audio remains separate.

+  Chromium recording-studio suite passed 9/9, the camera export contained audible audio, and 240 ms visual/audio
+  markers stayed within 150 ms at the beginning and end in both engines. The permission UI also distinguishes denied,
+  busy, and absent-device retries before an explicit silent-video choice. Chromium reported WebM VP9/Opus, WebM
+  VP8/Opus, generic WebM, and MP4 H.264/AAC candidates; Firefox reported WebM VP8/Opus and generic WebM, so the
+  recorder falls through to the first supported combination. The bundled Playwright WebKit 26.5 on Windows has no
+  `MediaRecorder` and disables the studio; this does not describe native Safari. The reported macOS device/browser

 - `/admin/community` manages the permanent community, including polls, project
   moderation, participants, memberships, payments, and room analytics.
 - `/admin/recording-studio` records any number of available cameras, screen shares,
-  and optional microphones as separate local tracks. One capture coordinator starts
-  and stops them on a shared clock; losing a source or a storage write stops the take.
+  and optional microphones. A newly configured camera defaults to recording its selected
+  system-default or chosen microphone inside the same video file; video-only is an explicit
+  choice. The live camera preview is muted, while a track-presence indicator and live level
+  meter describe the captured microphone. Standalone microphone and screen sources remain
+  available, and an already configured matching microphone is cloned without transferring
+  ownership or adding a second audio track to the camera file. Versioned browser-local source
+  preferences survive recording stops and reloads; restoration never starts capture or requests
+  permission by itself. One capture coordinator starts and stops sources on a shared clock; losing
+  a required source or a storage write stops the take.
   IndexedDB commits each chunk together with its counters; a feature-detected selected-directory destination
   closes immutable media fragments before its small authoritative checkpoint and stores only handles/metadata in
   IndexedDB. Recovery can reconnect or import that folder without moving its media into origin storage; read-only

   matching microphone track safely when it is also configured as a standalone source. Recording metadata and archive
   manifests now identify embedded camera audio and its selected microphone. Recorder containers and codecs are chosen
   from combinations accepted by the active browser, with construction-time fallback; standalone audio remains separate.
+  Verification on Windows 10 Pro build 19045 used Playwright Chromium 151.0.7922.34 and Firefox 153.0: the full
+  Chromium recording-studio suite passed 9/9, the camera export contained audible audio, and 240 ms visual/audio
+  markers stayed within 150 ms at the beginning and end in both engines. The permission UI also distinguishes denied,
+  busy, and absent-device retries before an explicit silent-video choice. Chromium reported WebM VP9/Opus, WebM
+  VP8/Opus, generic WebM, and MP4 H.264/AAC candidates; Firefox reported WebM VP8/Opus and generic WebM, so the
+  recorder falls through to the first supported combination. The bundled Playwright WebKit 26.5 on Windows has no
+  `MediaRecorder` and disables the studio; this does not describe native Safari. The reported macOS device/browser
+  setup was not available in this workspace, so its hardware verification remains outstanding.
 
 - Quick-link materials now pass only the trimmed original pasted URL as their body to ordinary material creation,
   preserving URL spelling, percent encoding, query strings and fragments. Scraped titles, fallback titles and title

 - `/admin/community` manages the permanent community, including polls, project
   moderation, participants, memberships, payments, and room analytics.
 - `/admin/recording-studio` records any number of available cameras, screen shares,
-  and optional microphones as separate local tracks. One capture coordinator starts
-  and stops them on a shared clock; losing a source or a storage write stops the take.
+  and optional microphones. A newly configured camera defaults to recording its selected
+  system-default or chosen microphone inside the same video file; video-only is an explicit
+  choice. The live camera preview is muted, while a track-presence indicator and live level
+  meter describe the captured microphone. Standalone microphone and screen sources remain
+  available, and an already configured matching microphone is cloned without transferring
+  ownership or adding a second audio track to the camera file. Versioned browser-local source
+  preferences survive recording stops and reloads; restoration never starts capture or requests
+  permission by itself. One capture coordinator starts and stops sources on a shared clock; losing
+  a required source or a storage write stops the take.
   IndexedDB commits each chunk together with its counters; a feature-detected selected-directory destination
   closes immutable media fragments before its small authoritative checkpoint and stores only handles/metadata in
   IndexedDB. Recovery can reconnect or import that folder without moving its media into origin storage; read-only

 - `/admin/community` manages the permanent community, including polls, project
   moderation, participants, memberships, payments, and room analytics.
 - `/admin/recording-studio` records any number of available cameras, screen shares,
-  and optional microphones as separate local tracks. One capture coordinator starts
-  and stops them on a shared clock; losing a source or a storage write stops the take.
+  and optional microphones. A newly configured camera defaults to recording its selected
+  system-default or chosen microphone inside the same video file; video-only is an explicit
+  choice. The live camera preview is muted, while a track-presence indicator and live level
+  meter describe the captured microphone. Standalone microphone and screen sources remain
+  available, and an already configured matching microphone is cloned without transferring
+  ownership or adding a second audio track to the camera file. Versioned browser-local source
+  preferences survive recording stops and reloads; restoration never starts capture or requests
+  permission by itself. One capture coordinator starts and stops sources on a shared clock; losing
+  a required source or a storage write stops the take.
   IndexedDB commits each chunk together with its counters; a feature-detected selected-directory destination
   closes immutable media fragments before its small authoritative checkpoint and stores only handles/metadata in
   IndexedDB. Recovery can reconnect or import that folder without moving its media into origin storage; read-only

+  busy, and absent-device retries before an explicit silent-video choice. Chromium reported WebM VP9/Opus, WebM
+  VP8/Opus, generic WebM, and MP4 H.264/AAC candidates; Firefox reported WebM VP8/Opus and generic WebM, so the
+  recorder falls through to the first supported combination. The bundled Playwright WebKit 26.5 on Windows has no

 - `/admin/community` manages the permanent community, including polls, project
   moderation, participants, memberships, payments, and room analytics.
 - `/admin/recording-studio` records any number of available cameras, screen shares,
-  and optional microphones as separate local tracks. One capture coordinator starts
-  and stops them on a shared clock; losing a source or a storage write stops the take.
+  and optional microphones. A newly configured camera defaults to recording its selected
+  system-default or chosen microphone inside the same video file; video-only is an explicit
+  choice. The live camera preview is muted, while a track-presence indicator and live level
+  meter describe the captured microphone. Standalone microphone and screen sources remain
+  available, and an already configured matching microphone is cloned without transferring
+  ownership or adding a second audio track to the camera file. Versioned browser-local source
+  preferences survive recording stops and reloads; restoration never starts capture or requests
+  permission by itself. One capture coordinator starts and stops sources on a shared clock; losing
+  a required source or a storage write stops the take.
   IndexedDB commits each chunk together with its counters; a feature-detected selected-directory destination
   closes immutable media fragments before its small authoritative checkpoint and stores only handles/metadata in
   IndexedDB. Recovery can reconnect or import that folder without moving its media into origin storage; read-only

   from combinations accepted by the active browser, with construction-time fallback; standalone audio remains separate.
+  Verification on Windows 10 Pro build 19045 used Playwright Chromium 151.0.7922.34 and Firefox 153.0: the full
+  Chromium recording-studio suite passed 9/9, the camera export contained audible audio, and 240 ms visual/audio
+  markers stayed within 150 ms at the beginning and end in both engines. The permission UI also distinguishes denied,
+  busy, and absent-device retries before an explicit silent-video choice. Chromium reported WebM VP9/Opus, WebM
+  VP8/Opus, generic WebM, and MP4 H.264/AAC candidates; Firefox reported WebM VP8/Opus and generic WebM, so the
+  recorder falls through to the first supported combination. The bundled Playwright WebKit 26.5 on Windows has no
+  `MediaRecorder` and disables the studio; this does not describe native Safari. The reported macOS device/browser

+  meter describe the captured microphone. Standalone microphone and screen sources remain
+  available, and an already configured matching microphone is cloned without transferring
+  ownership or adding a second audio track to the camera file. Versioned browser-local source
+  preferences survive recording stops and reloads; restoration never starts capture or requests
+  permission by itself. One capture coordinator starts and stops sources on a shared clock; losing
+  a required source or a storage write stops the take.

 - `/admin/community` manages the permanent community, including polls, project
   moderation, participants, memberships, payments, and room analytics.
 - `/admin/recording-studio` records any number of available cameras, screen shares,
-  and optional microphones as separate local tracks. One capture coordinator starts
-  and stops them on a shared clock; losing a source or a storage write stops the take.
+  and optional microphones. A newly configured camera defaults to recording its selected
+  system-default or chosen microphone inside the same video file; video-only is an explicit
+  choice. The live camera preview is muted, while a track-presence indicator and live level
+  meter describe the captured microphone. Standalone microphone and screen sources remain
+  available, and an already configured matching microphone is cloned without transferring
+  ownership or adding a second audio track to the camera file. Versioned browser-local source
+  preferences survive recording stops and reloads; restoration never starts capture or requests
+  permission by itself. One capture coordinator starts and stops sources on a shared clock; losing
+  a required source or a storage write stops the take.
   IndexedDB commits each chunk together with its counters; a feature-detected selected-directory destination
   closes immutable media fragments before its small authoritative checkpoint and stores only handles/metadata in
   IndexedDB. Recovery can reconnect or import that folder without moving its media into origin storage; read-only

# Current preversion

- New camera sources now default to `Kamera + mikrofon`: choose a camera and a system-default or separate microphone,
  with an explicit, enabled-by-default `Nahrávat zvuk` option. Camera and microphone are requested together and stored
  in the same camera media file; the muted preview stays separate from the captured audio. Existing source intent is
  retained in a versioned browser-local configuration, so a saved video-only choice stays silent and restored sources
  require an explicit reconnect. The studio shows microphone identity, audio-track presence and a live level meter,
  preserves a failed sound-enabled setup for retry or an explicit switch to silent video, and clones an already-open
  matching microphone track safely when it is also configured as a standalone source. Recording metadata and archive
  manifests now identify embedded camera audio and its selected microphone. Recorder containers and codecs are chosen
  from combinations accepted by the active browser, with construction-time fallback; standalone audio remains separate.
  Verification on Windows 10 Pro build 19045 used Playwright Chromium 151.0.7922.34 and Firefox 153.0: the full
  Chromium recording-studio suite passed 9/9, the camera export contained audible audio, and 240 ms visual/audio
  markers stayed within 150 ms at the beginning and end in both engines. Automated capture used generated canvas/audio
  sources in place of physical devices; browser recording, playback, storage and export remained real. The permission UI distinguishes denied,
  busy, and absent-device retries before an explicit silent-video choice. Chromium reported WebM VP9/Opus, WebM
  VP8/Opus, generic WebM, and MP4 H.264/AAC candidates; Firefox reported WebM VP8/Opus and generic WebM, so the
  recorder falls through to the first supported combination. The bundled Playwright WebKit 26.5 on Windows has no
  `MediaRecorder` and disables the studio; this does not describe native Safari. The reported macOS device/browser
  setup was not available in this workspace, so its hardware verification remains outstanding.

- Quick-link materials now pass only the trimmed original pasted URL as their body to ordinary material creation,

 - `/admin/community` manages the permanent community, including polls, project
   moderation, participants, memberships, payments, and room analytics.
 - `/admin/recording-studio` records any number of available cameras, screen shares,
-  and optional microphones as separate local tracks. One capture coordinator starts
-  and stops them on a shared clock; losing a source or a storage write stops the take.
+  and optional microphones. A newly configured camera defaults to recording its selected
+  system-default or chosen microphone inside the same video file; video-only is an explicit
+  choice. The live camera preview is muted, while a track-presence indicator and live level
+  meter describe the captured microphone. Standalone microphone and screen sources remain
+  available, and an already configured matching microphone is cloned without transferring
+  ownership or adding a second audio track to the camera file. Versioned browser-local source
+  preferences survive recording stops and reloads; restoration never starts capture or requests
+  permission by itself. One capture coordinator starts and stops sources on a shared clock; losing
+  a required source or a storage write stops the take.
   IndexedDB commits each chunk together with its counters; a feature-detected selected-directory destination
   closes immutable media fragments before its small authoritative checkpoint and stores only handles/metadata in
   IndexedDB. Recovery can reconnect or import that folder without moving its media into origin storage; read-only

 - `/admin/community` manages the permanent community, including polls, project
   moderation, participants, memberships, payments, and room analytics.
 - `/admin/recording-studio` records any number of available cameras, screen shares,
-  and optional microphones as separate local tracks. One capture coordinator starts
-  and stops them on a shared clock; losing a source or a storage write stops the take.
+  and optional microphones. A newly configured camera defaults to recording its selected
+  system-default or chosen microphone inside the same video file; video-only is an explicit
+  choice. The live camera preview is muted, while a track-presence indicator and live level
+  meter describe the captured microphone. Standalone microphone and screen sources remain
+  available, and an already configured matching microphone is cloned without transferring
+  ownership or adding a second audio track to the camera file. Versioned browser-local source
+  preferences survive recording stops and reloads; restoration never starts capture or requests
+  permission by itself. One capture coordinator starts and stops sources on a shared clock; losing
+  a required source or a storage write stops the take.
   IndexedDB commits each chunk together with its counters; a feature-detected selected-directory destination
   closes immutable media fragments before its small authoritative checkpoint and stores only handles/metadata in
   IndexedDB. Recovery can reconnect or import that folder without moving its media into origin storage; read-only

 - `/admin/community` manages the permanent community, including polls, project

 - `/admin/recording-studio` records any number of available cameras, screen shares,
-  and optional microphones as separate local tracks. One capture coordinator starts
-  and stops them on a shared clock; losing a source or a storage write stops the take.
+  and optional microphones. A newly configured camera defaults to recording its selected
+  system-default or chosen microphone inside the same video file; video-only is an explicit
+  choice. The live camera preview is muted, while a track-presence indicator and live level
+  meter describe the captured microphone. Standalone microphone and screen sources remain
+  available, and an already configured matching microphone is cloned without transferring
+  ownership or adding a second audio track to the camera file. Versioned browser-local source
+  preferences survive recording stops and reloads; restoration never starts capture or requests
+  permission by itself. One capture coordinator starts and stops sources on a shared clock; losing
+  a required source or a storage write stops the take.
   IndexedDB commits each chunk together with its counters; a feature-detected selected-directory destination
   closes immutable media fragments before its small authoritative checkpoint and stores only handles/metadata in
   IndexedDB. Recovery can reconnect or import that folder without moving its media into origin storage; read-only

 test('stops the whole take on disconnect and prevents a second tab from changing it', async ({ page, baseURL }) => {

codex
## Analysis

The camera path requested video with `audio: false`; the standalone microphone used a separate audio-only source. That explains the silent camera file without implying a macOS limitation. The capture spec allows requesting audio and video together, and the recording spec describes recording the tracks in the stream. It also cautions that a MIME support check alone doesn’t guarantee recording will succeed, so the implementation falls back when recorder construction fails and tests the encoded output. [Media Capture and Streams](https://www.w3.org/TR/mediacapture-streams/), [MediaStream Recording](https://www.w3.org/TR/mediastream-recording/)

## Implemented

New cameras default to a selected or system-default microphone, with **Nahrávat zvuk** enabled. Video-only remains explicit; saved preferences persist without automatically reconnecting devices or changing a saved silent choice. Standalone microphones remain available.

Camera and microphone audio are recorded in the same camera file. The studio shows the microphone, track presence, and a live level meter; the muted preview does not mute recorded audio. Matching microphone tracks are cloned safely. Required-track checks prevent a camera configured for sound from starting silently, and acquisition failures offer retry, another device, or an explicit video-only choice.

Recording metadata and the editor identify embedded camera audio. Source preferences and behavior notes are documented in [recordingStudioSourceConfiguration.ts](/C:/Users/me/work/promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages/aldaron/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioSourceConfiguration.ts), [RecordingStudioCapture.ts](/C:/Users/me/work/promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages/aldaron/lib/recording-studio/RecordingStudioCapture.ts), [RecordingEditor.tsx](/C:/Users/me/work/promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages/aldaron/components/recording-studio/RecordingEditor.tsx), [AGENTS.md](/C:/Users/me/work/promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages/aldaron/AGENTS.md), and the [changelog](/C:/Users/me/work/promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages/aldaron/changelog/_current-preversion.md).

## Verification

- `npm run test-types` passed; 39 focused unit tests passed.
- The full recording-studio E2E suite passed **9/9** on Windows 10 Pro build 19045 with Playwright Chromium **151.0.7922.34**. Firefox **153.0** also passed the camera-file media check.
- Tests confirmed audible audio in the exported camera file and visual/audio markers within **150 ms** near both the beginning and end. They also covered saved silent settings, permission denial, busy and absent devices, shared-microphone cloning, disconnects, and recovery.
- Automated capture used generated media in place of physical devices; browser recording, playback, storage, and export were real. Chromium reported WebM VP9/Opus, WebM VP8/Opus, generic WebM, and MP4 H.264/AAC support. Firefox reported WebM VP8/Opus and generic WebM.
- Playwright WebKit **26.5** on Windows exposes no `MediaRecorder`, so the studio is unavailable in that test build. This does not establish native Safari support or lack of support; Apple separately documents WebM MediaRecorder support in Safari 18.4. [Apple WWDC 2025](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2025/233/)

**Still unverified:** the owner’s physical macOS camera/microphone setup. This workspace is Windows-only, and the reported Mac browser/version and devices weren’t available to test. I requested those details; the automated results above do not substitute for that hardware check.

 test('stops the whole take on disconnect and prevents a second tab from changing it', async ({ page, baseURL }) => {

## Analysis

The camera path requested video with `audio: false`; the standalone microphone used a separate audio-only source. That explains the silent camera file without implying a macOS limitation. The capture spec allows requesting audio and video together, and the recording spec describes recording the tracks in the stream. It also cautions that a MIME support check alone doesn’t guarantee recording will succeed, so the implementation falls back when recorder construction fails and tests the encoded output. [Media Capture and Streams](https://www.w3.org/TR/mediacapture-streams/), [MediaStream Recording](https://www.w3.org/TR/mediastream-recording/)

## Implemented

New cameras default to a selected or system-default microphone, with **Nahrávat zvuk** enabled. Video-only remains explicit; saved preferences persist without automatically reconnecting devices or changing a saved silent choice. Standalone microphones remain available.

Camera and microphone audio are recorded in the same camera file. The stokens used
397,856
tudio shows the microphone, track presence, and a live level meter; the muted preview does not mute recorded audio. Matching microphone tracks are cloned safely. Required-track checks prevent a camera configured for sound from starting silently, and acquisition failures offer retry, another device, or an explicit video-only choice.

Recording metadata and the editor identify embedded camera audio. Source preferences and behavior notes are documented in [recordingStudioSourceConfiguration.ts](/C:/Users/me/work/promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages/aldaron/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioSourceConfiguration.ts), [RecordingStudioCapture.ts](/C:/Users/me/work/promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages/aldaron/lib/recording-studio/RecordingStudioCapture.ts), [RecordingEditor.tsx](/C:/Users/me/work/promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages/aldaron/components/recording-studio/RecordingEditor.tsx), [AGENTS.md](/C:/Users/me/work/promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages/aldaron/AGENTS.md), and the [changelog](/C:/Users/me/work/promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages/aldaron/changelog/_current-preversion.md).

## Verification

- `npm run test-types` passed; 39 focused unit tests passed.
- The full recording-studio E2E suite passed **9/9** on Windows 10 Pro build 19045 with Playwright Chromium **151.0.7922.34**. Firefox **153.0** also passed the camera-file media check.
- Tests confirmed audible audio in the exported camera file and visual/audio markers within **150 ms** near both the beginning and end. They also covered saved silent settings, permission denial, busy and absent devices, shared-microphone cloning, disconnects, and recovery.
- Automated capture used generated media in place of physical devices; browser recording, playback, storage, and export were real. Chromium reported WebM VP9/Opus, WebM VP8/Opus, generic WebM, and MP4 H.264/AAC support. Firefox reported WebM VP8/Opus and generic WebM.
- Playwright WebKit **26.5** on Windows exposes no `MediaRecorder`, so the studio is unavailable in that test build. This does not establish native Safari support or lack of support; Apple separately documents WebM MediaRecorder support in Safari 18.4. [Apple WWDC 2025](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2025/233/)

**Still unverified:** the owner’s physical macOS camera/microphone setup. This workspace is Windows-only, and the reported Mac browser/version and devices weren’t available to test. I requested those details; the automated results above do not substitute for that hardware check.
